evals.prompt: Run a full model audit on Northwind's model.xlsx before it goes to IC. Model scope.
assertions: Starts with the model summary line giving the model type, the overall rating, and the counts of critical, warning and info findings
Reports the FY26E balance sheet imbalance of 12.5 at BS!D15 as critical and traces it to the typed other-assets input at BS!D8
Reports the #REF! link at IS!D15 as a critical formula error
Uses the findings table columns (Sheet, Cell/Range, Severity, Category, Issue, Suggested Fix) and changes no cell

evals.prompt: Check my formulas on the IS sheet only. Sheet scope.
assertions: Limits findings to the IS sheet and reports no finding on the BS or CF sheets
Flags the typed 350.0 in IS!E8 as a hardcode inside a calculation row, with =E5*Inputs!E6 as the suggested fix
Flags IS!E6 as an inconsistent formula that breaks the pattern of IS!D6
Flags the #REF! link at IS!D15 (=Inputs!#REF!) as a critical broken cross-sheet link

evals.prompt: The balance sheet doesn't balance and I need to know by how much and why. Audit the whole model, model scope.
assertions: Reports the gap in each period (0.0, 12.5 and 20.0) and names BS!D8 as the cause of the FY26E gap
Says the FY27E gap originates on the CF sheet rather than the BS sheet
Changes no cell and offers to fix on request

evals.prompt: I've selected IS!D5:E13. Audit only this selection.
assertions: Limits findings to IS!D5:E13 and does not report IS!D15 or any other cell outside the selection
Flags IS!E8 (typed number) and IS!E6 (inconsistent formula) with suggested formulas, for example =E5*(1-Inputs!E5) for IS!E6
Uses the Warning severity for the hardcode and the inconsistent formula, as the skill's severity table requires

evals.prompt: The FY27E balance check on the BS doesn't show zero. Audit the whole model end to end and find out why.
assertions: Identifies the working-capital sign error at CF!E7 and gives the corrected formula =-(BS!E6-BS!D6)
Quantifies the effect: FY27E cash overstated by 20.0, which carries into the FY27E check at BS!E15
Changes no cell and asks before fixing, as the skill requires

Can you check the formulas in the range I've selected (C5:H40)? I think some of the SUMs are missing the last row.

QA this spreadsheet before I forward it to my VP — look for #REF errors, hardcodes buried in formulas, anything weird.
